about.title: Our team has been doing this for over 35 years.
text: Kovich A/C & Heating serves Galveston County and the surrounding areas, and our team has been in the industry for over 35 years.
We are known and recommended for honesty, integrity and quality workmanship, and we work for both residential and commercial customers.
Our technicians are available 24/7 for heating, cooling and indoor air quality, and we aim to give fast, affordable service you can rely on.
